```python
import pandas as pd
import zipfile
import requests
import io

# Download ZIP containing the indicator data
url = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/en/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS?downloadformat=csv"
resp = requests.get(url)
z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(resp.content))

# Identify files
names = z.namelist()
print(names)

# Load main data CSV (skip metadata rows)
main_file = [n for n in names if n.startswith('API_NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS_DS2') and n.endswith('.csv')][0]
with z.open(main_file) as f:
    df = pd.read_csv(f, skiprows=4)

# Filter to 2001-2010
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]
subset = df[['Country Name'] + years]
subset.to_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010.csv', index=False)
print(subset.head())

# Load country metadata to help filter aggregates
meta_country_file = [n for n in names if n.startswith('Metadata_Country_API_NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS_DS2') and n.endswith('.csv')][0]
with z.open(meta_country_file) as f:
    meta = pd.read_csv(f)
meta.to_csv('metadata_country.csv', index=False)
print(meta.head())
```

Great. Next, we will remove aggregates and apply the threshold filter. I will provide code that merges the subset with metadata to exclude aggregates/regions and then checks >35% for all years.

```python
import pandas as pd

subset = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
meta = pd.read_csv('metadata_country.csv')

# Merge to get Region info and filter to entries that look like countries (exclude aggregates by checking for a non-empty Region and excluding names with parentheses)
merged = subset.merge(meta[['Country Name','Region','IncomeGroup']], on='Country Name', how='left')

# Heuristic to exclude aggregates/regional groupings: Region should not be NaN, and name should not contain parentheses
is_country = merged['Region'].notna() & (~merged['Country Name'].str.contains('\('))
countries = merged[is_country].copy()

years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

def qualifies(row):
    vals = row[years]
    return vals.notnull().all() and (vals > 35).all()

qualified = countries[countries.apply(qualifies, axis=1)][['Country Name'] + years]
qualified.to_csv('qualified_raw.csv', index=False)
print('Qualified count:', len(qualified))
print(', '.join(sorted(qualified['Country Name'].tolist())))
```
